account.activity.colors_hint: Every kind of event has its own colour. New kinds appear as soon as you enable a plugin that brings its own.
account.activity.confirm_reset: Reset all colours to their defaults?
account.activity.lead: The feed shows what happens in your channel. Set its colours here.
account.activity.not_for_viewers: The feed is not meant as a %{source} in your stream – it is for you, not for viewers.
account.activity.obs_hint: Best used directly in OBS: %{menu}, then enter this address. Such a dock shares the sign-in with your browser, so you are already logged in.
account.plugins.all_current: All plugins are up to date.
account.plugins.catalog_unreachable: The catalogue is unreachable, so no updates are shown here. Managing still works. Reason: %{reason}
account.plugins.confirm_remove:
Really remove “%{name}”?

It will be switched off, all data and settings deleted, then the files. To use it again it has to be installed once more.
account.plugins.confirm_update_all:
Update %{count} plugin(s) now?

The files are replaced and the database schema is brought up to date. Your settings are kept.
account.plugins.data_gone_files_stay: The data of “%{name}” was deleted, the files could not be: %{reason}
account.plugins.enabled_hint: Plugin enabled. If it needs Twitch events, click “Sync subscriptions” once under Settings → Channel.
account.plugins.lead: Feature add-ons: overlay, alerts, goals, donations and whatever else comes along.
account.plugins.missing_files: These plugins are registered but their files are missing: %{slugs}. Either put the files back or remove the plugin.
account.plugins.needed_by: Needed by: %{plugins} – turn it off there first.
account.plugins.needed_by_others: “%{name}” is needed by %{plugins}. Remove that first, then this one – otherwise %{plugins} can never be switched on again.
account.plugins.removed: “%{name}” has been removed – data and files are deleted.
account.plugins.setup_done_hint: The core is running. Everything else comes as a plugin – the catalogue is under %{tab}.
account.plugins.update_all_hint: Fetches the newest version of every plugin from the catalogue and then brings its database schema up to date. A plugin that fails does not hold up the others.
account.users.cannot_remove_owner: The channel owner cannot be removed.
account.users.cannot_remove_self: You cannot remove your own account.
account.users.lead: Who else may use this control panel.
account.users.link_hint: Send this link to the person. They sign in with Twitch and are then registered.
account.users.name: Name
account.users.not_found_hint: They may have been removed in the meantime. Go back to the list and try again.
account.users.permissions_lead: Who may do what. Click Edit to change it – the permissions then open on their own page.
account.users.presets_hint: A preset sets every box at once. You can still change individual ones afterwards – the list then shows “Custom”.
account.users.superadmin_note: The superadmin always has every permission – the selection below has no effect.
auth.bad_return: The sign-in return path is invalid. Allow cookies and finish signing in in the same browser.
auth.login_expired: The sign-in has expired. Please try again.
auth.no_code: Twitch did not return a code.
auth.no_invite: There is no invitation for this account. Ask the channel owner for an invitation link.
auth.no_user: Twitch did not return a usable user.
auth.state_bad_signature: The sign-in return path is invalid: the signature does not match.
auth.state_missing: The sign-in return path is invalid: the state value is missing.
auth.state_unreadable: The sign-in return path is invalid: the state value is unreadable.
auth.user_unreadable: The user could not be read after signing in.
chat.error.dropped: Twitch did not send the message: %{reason}
chat.error.forbidden: Twitch denied permission. Usually a scope is missing – reconnect the channel.
chat.error.no_sender: No account is connected that could write.
chat.error.own_message: The channel owner’s own messages cannot be deleted.
chat.error.rate_limit: Too many messages in a short time. Wait a moment.
chat.error.too_old: The message is older than six hours. Twitch does not allow deleting that far back.
chat.error.unauthorized: Twitch refused the authorisation. Reconnect the channel in the settings.
common.error.form_expired: The form has expired. Please try again.
common.error.no_permission: You do not have permission for that.
common.error.owner_only: Only the channel owner may do that.
crypto.appkey_length: APP_KEY has to be 32 bytes (64 hex characters). Create one with: openssl rand -hex 32
crypto.sodium_missing: The PHP extension “sodium” is missing. Without it secrets cannot be encrypted.
crypto.undecryptable: The secret could not be decrypted. Was APP_KEY changed?
error.forbidden_hint: You do not have permission for this area. The channel owner can grant it.
error.heading: Something went wrong
error.hint: The details are in the container log: docker compose logs -f web
error.title: Error
feed.empty.hint: As soon as Twitch sends something it shows up here by itself.
feed.empty.nothing_selected: Nothing selected — tick something in the filter.
install.backup_failed: The existing version could not be moved aside.
install.bad_key: The stored public key is unusable.
install.bad_path: The package contains a forbidden path: %{path}
install.bad_signature: The signature of the package is invalid.
install.checksum_mismatch: The checksum does not match. The package is damaged or was altered.
install.download_aborted: The download was aborted. The package is probably too large.
install.foreign_host: The package sits on a different server (%{download}) than the catalogue (%{catalog}). For safety it is not installed.
install.move_failed: The new files could not be put in place.
install.no_checksum: The catalogue gives no checksum for this package. Without one nothing is installed.
install.no_tempfile: A temporary file could not be created.
install.no_workdir: A working directory could not be created.
install.not_a_plugin: The package is missing plugin.json or plugin.php. That is not a valid plugin.
install.not_writable: The plugins/ directory is not writable for the web server. Running “sudo ./install.sh” on the server once fixes it.
install.not_zip: The package is not a readable ZIP archive.
install.sodium_missing: Signature verification requires the PHP extension sodium.
install.tempfile_unreadable: The temporary file could not be opened.
install.too_large_unpacked: The package is too large when unpacked.
install.too_many_files: The package contains too many files.
install.unpack_failed: The package could not be unpacked.
install.unsigned: Signature verification is switched on for this installation, but the package is not signed.
install.wrong_slug: The package contains “%{found}”, but “%{wanted}” was requested.
login.invited: You have been invited. Sign in with Twitch to join.
login.only_invited: Only invited accounts can sign in.
login.title: Sign in
market.catalog_404_hint: Is the catalogue server really at that address, and is index.php reachable there?
market.catalog_not_json: %{url} does not respond with JSON. Start of the response: %{start}
market.confirm_with_deps: This plugin needs %{plugins}. That will be installed and enabled as well. Continue?
market.dependency_cycle: Two of these plugins require each other. No install order can be formed – that has to be fixed in the catalogue.
market.dependency_missing: %{plugins} is required but not in the catalogue. Without it this plugin cannot be installed.
market.installed_blocked: %{name} is installed but not active yet: %{reasons}
market.live: The catalogue is fetched directly from %{source} on every visit.
market.manifest_broken: The files are there, but the plugin cannot be read. Its manifest is probably broken.
market.needs_newer_core_hint: This plugin requires a newer core version (%{version}). Update the system first: %{path}.
market.needs_unknown: not in the catalogue – the installation will be refused
market.no_such_plugin_hint: It is not in the catalogue. It may have been withdrawn.
market.not_in_catalog: This plugin is not in the catalogue.
market.not_writable: The directory %{directory} is not writable for the web server, so installing does not work. Running %{command} on the server once fixes it.
market.not_writable_short: The plugin directory is not writable for the web server.
market.readme.failed: The description could not be loaded: %{reason}
market.readme.foreign_host: The description would come from a different server than the catalogue. It is not loaded.
market.remove.bad_slug: That is not a valid plugin name.
market.remove.failed: The files of %{slug} could not be deleted completely. The web server is probably missing permissions.
market.remove.outside: That folder is not inside the plugin directory. Nothing is deleted.
market.remove.still_installed: This plugin is still installed. Remove it first – that cleans up its data – then the files can be deleted.
market.try_other: Try other search terms or reset the filters.
overlay.canvas_hint: The surface is scaled to the size of the source in OBS. Plugins therefore work in these pixels, however large you drag the source.
overlay.canvas_invalid: Width and height must be between 320×180 and 7680×4320.
overlay.debug_hint: Shows a dot in the bottom left: green means connected, red means disconnected. For troubleshooting – turn it off again for the stream.
overlay.lead: The surface that runs in OBS. It shows nothing by itself – plugins such as alerts or goals draw into its slots.
overlay.login_needed_hint: A browser source cannot sign in by itself. In OBS right-click the source, then Interact – sign in once there. OBS remembers it afterwards.
overlay.open_source: Open the surface in the browser
overlay.slots_hint: Each slot is a box on the surface. Plugins register their own slots – here you see which ones exist right now.
overlay.source_hint: Add a browser source in OBS and enter %{url} as its address. Width and height as configured below.
overlay.test_hint: The test appears on the surface for four seconds. To see it, the surface has to be open – in the browser or in OBS.
overlay.title: Overlay
permissions.activity.manage: may change the feed's colours and display.
permissions.activity.view: may view the channel activity feed.
permissions.overlay.manage: may change the size and slots of the overlay.
permissions.overlay.view: may see the overlay and its settings.
permissions.plugins.manage: may install, enable and remove plugins.
permissions.users.manage: may invite users, set permissions and remove them.
plugin.blocker.version: Plugin “%{name}” is installed as %{installed}, but %{constraint} is required.
plugin.disable_blocked: Deactivate %{names} first – it depends on this.
registry.error.format_newer: The catalogue uses format %{format}, this system understands up to format %{support}. Please update the system.
rescue.language_hint: In case the interface is in the wrong language.
rescue.lead: This page works without navigation and without plugins. That is why it still loads when another page no longer does.
rescue.title: Emergency exit
rescue.update_hint: Version %{version} is installed. Check first, then apply.
roles.editor.hint: May change everything except users and the Twitch connection.
roles.helper.hint: May look at everything and operate the stream side – alerts, goals, overlay content. Nothing about users or credentials.
roles.readonly.hint: May look at everything but change nothing.
scope.bits.why: so that donated bits are reported
scope.bot_channel: Allow a chat account in your channel
scope.bot_channel.why: so reading and writing in the channel is permitted
scope.bot_user.why: so Twitch accepts this account as a chat participant
scope.broadcast.why: to set the stream info from this interface
scope.chat_read.why: so messages arrive and chat commands can be recognised
scope.followers.why: so that new follows arrive in the stream
scope.goals.why: for the progress bars from Twitch
scope.hype.why: to show the hype train on the overlay
scope.raids.why: to start raids from this interface
scopes.missing_banner_hint: Permission is missing for %{count} switched-on feature(s) – they silently do nothing.
settings.app.owner_only: Only the channel owner may view and change the credentials.
settings.app.redirect: The redirect URL in the Twitch console must be: %{url}
settings.app.secret_set: set – leave empty to keep it
settings.app.webhook_hint: After a change the subscriptions must be recreated – the secret is passed when subscribing and cannot be changed afterwards.
settings.channel.confirm_disconnect: Disconnect? Events and plugins that need Twitch data will stop working.
settings.channel.lead: Which channel is connected, which Twitch permissions were granted, and which events Twitch sends.
settings.channel.missing: Permissions are missing on your channel.
settings.channel.missing_hint: Twitch does not allow us these things yet – until then the matching notifications stay off:
settings.channel.missing_why: This happens when an update or a new plugin needs more than was granted the last time you connected. Reconnecting once is enough – Twitch will then ask for the missing permissions.
settings.channel.title: Channel
settings.events.hint: Twitch sends events to %{url}. Which subscriptions are needed follows from the core plus the active plugins – sync once after enabling or disabling anything.
settings.events.title: Event subscriptions
settings.language_hint: Further languages are added by creating a %{file} file.
settings.lead: Twitch connection and state of this installation.
settings.nav_order.failed: That area cannot be moved any further.
settings.nav_order.hint: The order the areas appear in on the left. An area from a newly installed plugin lands at the bottom and can be moved up from here.
settings.nav_order.title: Order in the menu
settings.nav_order.too_few: There is only one area – nothing to sort.
settings.secrets.lead: The credentials of your Twitch app. Rarely changed here – and when, then deliberately.
settings.secrets.title: Secrets
settings.system.cannot_update: This installation cannot update itself – either it is not a Git checkout, or %{git} is missing in the container. Running %{command} on the server once fixes both.
settings.system.needs_shell: This update also changes things on the server itself, so it cannot be applied from here – it needs a command on the server:
settings.system.queued: The update has been queued and is running in the background. Reload this page in a minute.
settings.system.title: System
settings.timezone_hint: Determines which times are shown everywhere. The server works in UTC internally – without the right zone the feed shows times that are off.
settings.update.queued: The update has been queued. It runs in the background and usually takes less than a minute - reload this page afterwards.
settings.webhook_length: The webhook secret has to be between 10 and 100 characters.
setup.appkey_bad: missing or not 32 bytes. Create one with: openssl rand -hex 32
setup.channel.lead: Now sign in with the Twitch account whose channel this is about. That account also becomes the owner of this installation.
setup.channel.more_later: If you later install plugins that need more, you will be asked to reconnect the channel.
setup.channel.no_scopes: No additional permissions are needed right now – just the sign-in itself. Plugins can request more later.
setup.channel.title: Connect channel
setup.channel.use_channel_account: Sign in to Twitch with the channel account, not with a bot or secondary account. Twitch will ask which account to use.
setup.check.fix_env: Please fix the items marked red in %{env} and reload this page. Use %{example} as a template.
setup.check.lead: Before we start, let's check that the server has everything.
setup.check.title: Welcome
setup.credentials.category: Category and client type are up to you – "Website Integration" and "Confidential" work well. Then click %{button} and paste both values here.
setup.credentials.lead: Every installation needs its own Twitch application. It takes two minutes to create.
setup.credentials.register: Register an application at %{site}. Enter exactly this address as %{field}:
setup.credentials.secret_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
setup.credentials.title: Connect Twitch app
setup.credentials.webhook_hint: Twitch uses this to sign the events sent to %{url}. The suggestion was just generated and can stay as it is – it does not need to be entered anywhere else.
setup.credentials_both: Both the client ID and the client secret are required.
setup.db_unreachable: unreachable. Check DB_HOST, DB_NAME, DB_USER and DB_PASS in the .env.
setup.events.after_reconnect: You will end up back here and click "Create subscriptions" once more.
setup.events.basics: This is the basic set for the activity feed. Plugins will register further subscriptions later (goals, hype train, channel points) – those are added automatically.
setup.events.lead: Finally, we tell Twitch what we want to be notified about.
setup.events.removed_old: Removed %{count} old subscriptions – they came from an earlier installation and would no longer have delivered valid messages.
setup.events.title: Set up events
setup.ext.label: PHP extension %{name}
setup.https_required: Twitch only accepts HTTPS addresses for EventSub and OAuth.
setup.locked.lead: This installation already has an owner. Only they can continue the setup.
setup.locked.title: Setup locked
setup.plugins_writable_hint: Only needed to install plugins through this interface.
setup.schema_failed: The schema could not be created: %{reason}
setup.title: Setup
setup.webhook_length_setup: The webhook secret has to be between 10 and 100 characters (a Twitch rule).
twitch.app_token_failed: The app token could not be obtained: %{reason}
twitch.bad_signature: EventSub: the signature is invalid, or headers are missing.
twitch.eventsub.already_exists_fix: Nothing to do – the message disappears on the next sync.
twitch.eventsub.callback_failed: Twitch could not confirm the address. It is called immediately when subscribing and must be reachable from outside over HTTPS.
twitch.eventsub.callback_failed_fix: Open the address once from another network, for example from a phone on mobile data. If it does not work there, it will not work for Twitch either.
twitch.eventsub.https_fix: APP_URL in the .env must start with https://.
twitch.eventsub.limit: Twitch hit a rate or quota limit.
twitch.eventsub.limit_fix: Wait a few minutes and sync again.
twitch.eventsub.no_authorization: The channel has not granted this Twitch app the required permission.
twitch.eventsub.no_authorization_fix: Reconnect the channel once – Twitch will then ask for the missing permission.
twitch.no_client_id: The Twitch client ID is not set. Please finish the setup.
twitch.no_client_secret: The Twitch client secret is not set. Please finish the setup.
twitch.no_token: There is no Twitch token for “%{purpose}”. Please connect it in the settings.
twitch.user_unreadable: The Twitch user could not be loaded: %{reason}
update.no_git_binary: The container is missing the git program.
update.not_fast_forward: The folder cannot be fast-forwarded. Local changes?
update.not_git: This installation is not a git checkout. Updates then have to be applied by hand.
